title: Watchfloor's country attention and violence, rebuilt from GDELT Events with Watchfloor's own code
description: One row per country-day: distinct GDELT articles with an event located there, and with a violent event, each with its 28-day z, and whether the country was on Watchfloor's Rising list (the wf-28d anomaly triage reads as unusual attention).

sources.name: GDELT Events 2.0, 15-minute export files (English and translated streams)
sources.licence: GDELT: free and open for any use with citation

differences: Country items only. Watchfloor's zone items (attention on press named for a zone, from GDELT's GKG) are not rebuilt; triage also counts those.
Built from GDELT's files as they stand now; the live cycle read them within minutes.
FIPS codes sharing one ISO code (West Bank and Gaza: PS) are merged; the live feed keeps them apart.
